vulns.description: Flask may respond with a cached session cookie belonging to another user when a proxy caches a response that sets a cookie and the Vary header is not set correctly.
Werkzeug multipart form data parser allocates memory per part without bound, allowing denial of service.
Werkzeug debugger may allow remote code execution when the host header is attacker-controlled and the PIN is bypassed.
Jinja2 xmlattr filter accepts keys containing spaces and other characters, permitting attribute injection.
urllib3 does not strip the Cookie header on cross-origin redirects.
urllib3 does not remove the request body when a redirect changes the method to GET.
idna.encode may take a quadratic amount of time on specially crafted inputs, enabling denial of service.
certifi bundles root certificates from TrustCor, whose ownership raised trust concerns.
certifi bundles e-Tugra root certificates that were removed following a security incident.

Pygments regular expressions in multiple lexers are vulnerable to ReDoS on crafted input. NOTE: for baobao-batch-worker this dependency is NOT reachable from any runtime code path — see SEEDED-VULNERABILITIES.md, CVE scenario 7.
requests leaks the Proxy-Authorization header to the destination server on cross-origin redirects. Also reported by the Trivy image scan — the two collapse to one finding.
gunicorn improperly validates Transfer-Encoding headers, enabling HTTP request smuggling. Also reported by the Trivy image scan — the two collapse to one finding.
